_comment: The exact source of every third-party part a release ships under the GPL or LGPL (Round 17). the release preflight (`ffmpeg-source`, `source-bundle`) refuses to publish while any entry lacks its URL and SHA-256, or the FFmpeg sidecar enables a library not listed here. FFmpeg's list comes from the sidecar's own `ffmpeg -version`; only pure Windows interfaces carry no source.
